page_title: VAL 4-2 BET | Valencia v Betis 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
90+8' Assane Diao (Betis) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+6' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) makes a rough challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
90+5' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Cesar Tarrega (Valencia).
90+4' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) went to the ground quite willingly.
90+3' Valencia control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+1' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Luis Rioja as he is replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) was quite harsh and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
88' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea shows a yellow card to Cedric Bakambu (Betis) for his blatant foul.
86' Booking. Andre Almeida (Valencia) receives a caution from the referee.
86' The linesman signals that Assane Diao (Betis) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
84' Andre Almeida (Valencia) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Rui Silva comes off his line to intercept.
83' The linesman raises his flag. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is adjudged offside.
83' Juanmi (Betis) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
82' Here is a change. Javi Guerra is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Andre Almeida (Valencia).
81' It is time for a substitution. Assane Diao (Betis) is on for Vitor Roque.
80' Flag goes up against Dani Gomez (Valencia) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) brings an opponent down and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupts the game.
78' 11:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 5:3.
76' German Valera (Valencia) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
75' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
75' Substitution. Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) replaces Enzo Barrenechea.
74' Substitution. Hugo Duro walks off the pitch and Dani Gomez (Valencia) comes on as a substitute.
74' Ruben Baraja decides to make a substitution. Diego Lopez will be replaced by German Valera (Valencia).
73' Jose Gaya (Valencia) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
71' Vitor Roque (Betis) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
71' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Giorgi Mamardashvili intercepts the ball.
70' Betis are seeing far more of the ball now.
68' Abde Ezzalzouli comes off the pitch to be replaced by Juanmi (Betis).

66' 4 - 2 Goal! Chimy Avila (Betis) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Giorgi Mamardashvili is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 4:2.
66' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Betis was in an offside position.
65' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
64' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
62' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is flagged for offside.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.

61' Chimy Avila (Betis) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome. Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
58' Substitution. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Aitor Ruibal walks off.
57' Substitution. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) in, Carlos Guirao out.
57' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Iker Losada is replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).
56' 4 - 1 What a hit! Diego Lopez (Valencia) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top right corner. 4:1.
55' The Valencia players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
53' 3 - 1 Goal! Javi Guerra gets to the ball, slips Hugo Duro (Valencia) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 3:1.
50' 2 - 1 Hugo Duro (Valencia) shows good awareness deep inside the box and fires a sharp volley towards the left post, giving the goalkeeper no chance. Wonderful effort!
50' Javi Guerra (Valencia) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it.
49' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
48' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
47' A lofted pass finds Diego Lopez (Valencia) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the right post.
47' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
46' Vitor Roque (Betis) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.

45+6' Marc Bartra (Betis) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
45+6' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) prepares to take a corner kick.
45+5' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
45+4' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Diego Lopez (Valencia) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
45+4' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupts the game. One of the players from Betis won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Post! Diego Lopez (Valencia) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the centre of the box wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the right post!
45' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
44' Iker Losada (Betis) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
42' Iker Losada (Betis) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
42' Carlos Guirao (Betis) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea no option but to blow his whistle.
40' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:2. Shots on target – 1:2.
39' Luis Rioja (Valencia) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.

38' Natan (Betis) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul. Valencia earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
38' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
36' Flag up against Vitor Roque (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
35' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
34' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
31' Javi Guerra (Valencia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
29' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
24' Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
20' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) is awarded a yellow card.
18' Valencia get a corner.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Betis.

16' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
14' 1 - 1 OWN GOAL! The free kick is whipped in and Hugo Duro (Valencia) is unlucky enough to head the ball into his own net. 1:1.
13' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Betis are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

12' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Giorgi Mamardashvili anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
10' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Romain Perraud (Betis).
8' 1 - 0 Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) meets a cross from a well-taken corner kick and drills the ball towards the goal. His effort goes into the middle of the goal and hits the net.
8' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
7' Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
6' Vitor Roque (Betis) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
4' A pass from Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is intercepted by Giorgi Mamardashvili and the move breaks down.
4' Javi Guerra (Valencia) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Hugo Duro, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
3' Javi Guerra (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' A player from Betis commits a rough challenge. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Valencia will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
